newsitem.title: USA: Duchess of York meets with Hollywood executives.
newsitem.headline: Duchess of York meets with Hollywood executives.

text.p: Duchess of York Sarah Ferguson met with Hollywood executives on Wednesday to discuss the possibility of an American television talk show but she declined to say if a deal was near.
At a signing for her book "My Story" in nearby Pasadena, Ferguson ducked questions about a TV deal that reports said could net her up to $20 million.
"Lots of people ask lots of questions, but my children come first," she told Reuters. "It's (a television show) going to be difficult with the traveling."
She divorced Britain's Prince Andrew this year and has two young children.
Ferguson's spokesman Jeff Schneider said the interest was kindled by Ferguson's successful appearances on several talk shows last month.
"She's meeting with executives (this week). They are generally interested in having her do her own show," Schneider said.
Ferguson has more meetings scheduled for Thursday.
British newspapers have reported that Ferguson, widely known as "Fergie," has negotiated a $4.8 million Hollywood deal that could rise as high as $20 million if she meets television rating targets.
Schneider said such reports were premature.
"The Duchess is working on a number of projects and we're not going to make any announcement until deals are closed," he said.
